summary: Hard-coded ShutdownManager poll interval (250ms) causes slow test teardown in env-per-test setups. Request to expose this as a configurable option to reduce teardown time from 500ms to ~7ms.
userImpact: Users running env-per-test setups experience slow test teardown (500ms+) due to hard-coded poll interval.
rootCause: ShutdownManager.CHECK_PERIOD_MS is hard-coded to 250ms, which dominates shutdown time in env-per-test scenarios.
proposedFix: Expose poll interval as builder option (TestEnvironmentOptions#setShutdownCheckInterval(Duration)) or system property (temporal.worker.shutdownCheckPeriodMs).
workaround: Locally patch the CHECK_PERIOD_MS constant to a lower value.
keyQuote: In env-per-test setups this dominates wall-time customer measured shutdown p50 = 506 ms (stock) vs 7 ms (after locally patching the constant).
